source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "subaltern urbanization" OR "subaltern urbanisation" OR "small and medium towns"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"subaltern urbanization" OR "subaltern urbanisation" OR "small and medium towns",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("small and medium towns" OR "subaltern urbanisation" OR "subaltern urbanization")
